query: Inspect ./fixtures/counties.parquet. Show its geometry metadata, schema, two NAME and POP records, and spatial index statistics.
expected_behavior: Uses portal tools parquet rather than introducing an unrelated Parquet library
Uses meta, schema, a bounded query with projected columns, and stats with a spatial column path
Reports missing fields or metadata as errors instead of guessing replacements

query: Upload ./counties as a private Parquet Feature Layer item named Counties.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that the current portal item parquet upload implementation shares new items publicly
Stops before upload because the requested privacy guarantee cannot be met
Explains that upload creates a Parquet Feature Layer item with resources rather than a hosted feature service

query: Replace item 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef with ./counties-v2 and regenerate its spatial metadata.
expected_behavior: Uses portal item parquet update with the explicit item ID instead of relying on selection or upload --overwrite
Adds --spatial and explains the resource-directory swap
Verifies item metadata, resource listing, and spatial metadata after the update

query: Upload ./roads to container datasets in Azure storage alias prod at parquet/roads and create an app that renders the Parquet files.
expected_behavior: Synchronizes the Azure CDN route cache before the CDN-dependent workflow
Inspects local metadata, uploads recursively, verifies the destination, generates spatial metadata when geometry is present, and opens portal tools azure file app
States that the result is an ArcGIS Play document rather than a Portal Application item
Reconciles expected and uploaded paths before retrying a partial upload or post-upload CDN failure
